gauntlet.intent: T5 main-ladder #1: MULTI-DOMAIN CONCURRENT THEATER OP (primary dimension) -- extends tier 4's proven 2-thread ASW+AAW concurrency pattern (gauntlet-20260727-1455-t4-s1/-t4-s4) to 4 concurrent mission threads inside one 40-tick run: PATROL (p-960-skjold vs skr-admiral-grigorovich-pr-1135-6m/mrk-shkval-pr-22800-karakurt surface pickets, patrol_window_open @2), STRIKE (jas-39e-gripen-ng-2021 vs su-34-fullback-2014, strike_window_open @6), ESCORT/AAW (f-219-sachsen-type-f124-2006 vs su-35s-flanker-m-2023/su-33-flanker-d raid, escort_window_open @10), and ASW (ssn-774-virginia-blk-i-ii + nh90-nfh-caiman-marine + p-3c-orion-update-iii-2023 vs pla-885m-severodvinsk-yasen-m/pl-877-kilo-paltus-1992/pla-971-akula-i-improved-shchuka-b, asw_window_open @14). As in t4-s1/-s4, no mission.trigger is used here -- the concurrency claim rests purely on the timeline + fleet-wide friendlyRoe=WeaponsFree/opposingRoe=WeaponsFree engage config, with the denial term coming entirely from ScenarioContactLifecycle ID-gating (classifyAfterTicks=5/identifyAfterTicks=10, scaled up from t4's 3/6 and 4/8 pairs for this tier's 40-tick budget) so kills, denials and missilesFired are all simultaneously non-trivial. all_domains_concurrent_checkpoint @24 confirms all four windows are still live with 16 ticks of run remaining. NOT USED: contacts[] -- no scripted mid-run contact appearances anywhere in this policy; see production/qa/bugs/BUG-scenario-contacts-shadowed-by-detection.md (BalticReplayHarness.RunCore only constructs ScenarioContactSimulator in an else-if branch unreachable whenever detection[] is non-empty, which it is here). SECONDARY DIMENSION -- CONTESTED EM/EMCON DISCIPLINE (disclosed, static): ssn-774-virginia-blk-i-ii and nh90-nfh-caiman-marine are declared radar=Passive. Two real constraints are disclosed here, not invented: (1) ScenarioEmconResolver (src/ProjectAegis.Sim/Scenario/ScenarioEmconResolver.cs) resolves EmconState once at scenario load with no mid-run mutation path -- same constraint already disclosed in gauntlet-20260727-1455-t4-s3. (2) A closer read of the consumer (DeterministicDetectionLoop.RollTick, src/ProjectAegis.Sim/Sensors/DeterministicDetectionLoop.cs:99-103) shows EMCON specifically gates the OBSERVER side of a requiresActiveRadar:true detection trial (`if (trial.RequiresActiveRadar && ResolveRadar(trial.ObserverId) != Active) continue;`) -- it is a cost to the passive unit's OWN sensor picture, not a target-signature/stealth reduction for how easily others detect it. Neither ssn-774-virginia-blk-i-ii (observer only via passive-sonar-1/requiresActiveRadar:false, c-s1-1) nor nh90-nfh-caiman-marine (observer only via sonar-dipping-1/requiresActiveRadar:false, c-s1-2) holds a requiresActiveRadar:true observer role in this policy, so this EMCON declaration is a doctrinal/data-level EM-discipline posture flag with no additional observable fingerprint delta beyond what their sensor loadout already implies -- disclosed honestly rather than overclaimed as a functioning stealth effect, and more precise than gauntlet-20260727-1455-t4-s3's equivalent (undisclosed) inertness.
gauntlet.oracle: All five EventFired codes (patrol_window_open @2, strike_window_open @6, escort_window_open @10, asw_window_open @14, all_domains_concurrent_checkpoint @24) must appear in the fingerprint regardless of seed (pure tick-scheduled mission.events, not contact-dependent). BLUE (WeaponsFree throughout, both sides free) is expected to register kills across at least two of the four domains inside the 40-tick run, converting some of c-s1-1..c-s1-8's Pd-gated detections into engagements once ScenarioContactLifecycle classifies/identifies each contact (5/10-tick gate). Denials accrue only from the pre-identification gate, not ROE, and should be a modest fraction of the run given the 40-tick budget affords ample time past the 10-tick identify threshold. RED (also WeaponsFree) is expected to convert some of its own detections (c-s1-9, c-s1-11) into kills against BLUE, but only BLUE is scored (expect.side=BLUE). No requireFingerprintSubstrings assertion is made about EMCON having a distinct observable effect, per the disclosure above -- its only real effect (gating the observer's own requiresActiveRadar:true trials) is not exercised by either declared-passive unit here.
